28527-the-story-of-nathan-hale.creator: Henry Fisk Carlton
28527-the-story-of-nathan-hale.description: A book by Henry Fisk Carlton. new to you, but these are necessary, for you are now in a radio broadcasting studio, talking in front of a microphone. The word (_in_) means that the character is standing close to the microphone, while (_off_) indicates that he is farther away, so that his voice sounds faint.

arxiv-2110-02145.title: Analyzing the Intrinsic Magnetic Field in the Galactic Center Radio Arc Journal: ApJ MIRIAD, ( Sault et al. 1995 ) , Astropy ( Greenfield et al. 2014 ) , CASA ( McMullin et al. 2007 ) , LMFIT ( Newville et al. 2016 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 )
arxiv-2110-02145.creator: Dylan M. Paré, Cormac R. Purcell, Cornelia C. Lang, Mark R. Morris, James A. Green
arxiv-2110-02145.description: Abstract The Radio Arc is a system of organized non-thermal filaments (NTFs) located within the Galactic Center (GC) region of the Milky Way. Recent observations of the Radio Arc NTFs revealed a magnetic field which alternates between being parallel and rotated with respect to the orientation of the filaments.

arxiv-2112-10728.title: MuMuQA: Multimedia Multi-Hop News Question Answering via Cross-Media Knowledge Extraction and Grounding
arxiv-2112-10728.creator: Revanth Gangi Reddy, Xilin Rui, Manling Li, Xudong Lin, Haoyang Wen, Jaemin Cho, Lifu Huang, Mohit Bansal, Avirup Sil, Shih-Fu Chang, Alexander Schwing, Heng Ji
arxiv-2112-10728.description: Abstract Recently, there has been an increasing interest in building question answering (QA) models that reason across multiple modalities, such as text and images. However, QA using images is often limited to just picking the answer from a pre-defined set of options.

arxiv-2202-04336.title: Prospects for extra Higgs boson search via 𝒑 𝒑 → 𝑯 , 𝑨 → 𝝉 𝝁 , 𝝉 𝝉 pp\to H,A\to\tau\mu,\tau\tau at the High Luminosity Large Hadron Collider

arxiv-2212-04263.title: Fast, noise-free atomic optical memory with 35% end-to-end efficiency
arxiv-2212-04263.creator: Omri Davidson, Ohad Yogev, Eilon Poem, Ofer Firstenberg
arxiv-2212-04263.description: Abstract Coherent optical memories will likely play an important role in future quantum communication networks. Among the different platforms, memories based on ladder-type orbital transitions in atomic gasses offer high bandwidth ( > 100 >100 MHz), continuous (on-demand) readout, and low-noise operation.

arxiv-2309-11439.title: Controlled Generation with Prompt Insertion for Natural Language Explanations in Grammatical Error Correction
arxiv-2309-11439.creator: Masahiro Kaneko, Naoaki Okazaki
arxiv-2309-11439.description: Abstract In Grammatical Error Correction (GEC), it is crucial to ensure the user’s comprehension of a reason for correction. Existing studies present tokens, examples, and hints as to the basis for correction but do not directly explain the reasons for corrections.

arxiv-2401-10035.title: Dynamical vortex production and quantum turbulence in perturbed Bose-Einstein condensates
arxiv-2401-10035.creator: Lauro Tomio, A. N. da Silva, S. Sabari, R. Kishor Kumar
arxiv-2401-10035.description: Abstract Dynamical vortex production and quantum turbulence emerging in periodic perturbed quasi-two-dimensional (q2D) Bose-Einstein condensates are reported by considering two distinct time-dependent approaches. In both cases, dynamical simulations were performed by solving the corresponding 2D mean-field Gross-Pitaevskii formalism. (i) In the first model, a binary mass-imbalanced system is slightly perturbed by a stirring time-dependent elliptic external potential.

arxiv-2408-04167.title: mbrs : A Library for Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
arxiv-2408-04167.creator: Hiroyuki Deguchi, Yusuke Sakai, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Taro Watanabe
arxiv-2408-04167.description: Abstract Minimum Bayes risk (MBR) decoding is a decision rule of text generation tasks that outperforms conventional maximum a posterior (MAP) decoding using beam search by selecting high-quality outputs based on a utility function rather than those with high-probability. Typically, it finds the most suitable hypothesis from the set of hypotheses under the sampled pseudo-references.

arxiv-2507-00640.title: Forward Reverse Kernel Regression for the Schrödinger bridge problem
arxiv-2507-00640.creator: Denis Belomestny 1, John Schoenmakers 2
arxiv-2507-00640.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP), which is central to entropic optimal transport. For general reference processes and begin–endpoint distributions, we propose a forward-reverse iterative Monte Carlo procedure to approximate the Schrödinger potentials in a nonparametric way.

arxiv-2507-19545.title: Simulation of Emergency Evacuation in Large Scale Metropolitan Railway Systems for Urban Resilience
arxiv-2507-19545.creator: Hangli Ge 1 , Xiaojie Yang 2 , Zipei Fan 3 , Francesco Flammini 4 , Noboru Koshizuka 1
arxiv-2507-19545.description: Abstract This paper presents a simulation for traffic evacuation during railway disruptions to enhance urban resilience. The research focuses on large-scale railway networks and provides flexible simulation settings to accommodate multiple node or line failures. The evacuation optimization model is mathematically formulated using matrix computation and nonlinear programming.

openalex-w7204532421.title: PIRATARIA FLUVIAL E MEIO AMBIENTE DO TRABALHO: REPERCUSSÕES NA SAÚDE MENTAL DOS TRABALHADORES DA NAVEGAÇÃO INTERIOR NO AMAZONAS
openalex-w7204532421.creator: Marcelo de Vargas Estrella, Sâmara Christina Souza Nogueira, Emerson Victor Hugo Costa de Sá, Márcia Cristina Nery da Fonseca Rocha Medina
openalex-w7204532421.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7204532421.description: O artigo analisa a pirataria fluvial como fator de risco psicossocial no meio ambiente de trabalho dos trabalhadores da navegação interior no Amazonas e identifica deveres jurídicos de prevenção e resposta. Adota-se abordagem qualitativa, método dedutivo e pesquisa bibliográfica

pmc-10503334.title: Demand of and Access to Health Messages Through Mass Media in the Rural Community of Eastern Ethiopia: A Mixed Method Study
pmc-10503334.creator: Bushra Aliyi, Yadeta Dassie, Alemayehu Deressa, Adera Debella, Abdi Birhanu, Mulugeta Gamachu, Addis Eyeberu, Gelana Mamo Ayana, Hamdi Fekredin, Ibsa Mussa
pmc-10503334.description: BackgroundThe demand for health-related information has increased dramatically in recent years. Media is crucial in reaching health messages to audiences, especially those who are distant and rural. Therefore, the study aimed to assess demands, access, and factors associated with access to health messages through mass media in the rural community of Kersa District of East Hararghe, Eastern Ethiopia.

pmc-10671345.title: Revisiting the Asian Buffalo Leech (Hirudinaria manillensis) Genome: Focus on Antithrombotic Genes and Their Corresponding Proteins
pmc-10671345.creator: Zichao Liu, Fang Zhao, Zuhao Huang, Qingmei Hu, Renyuan Meng, Yiquan Lin, Jianxia Qi, Gonghua Lin, Wenping Zhang
pmc-10671345.description: Leeches are well-known annelids due to their obligate blood-feeding habits. Some leech species secrete various biologically active substances which have important medical and pharmaceutical value in antithrombotic treatments. In this study, we provided a high-quality genome of the Asian buffalo leech (Hirudinaria manillensis), based on which we performed a systematic identification of potential antithrombotic genes and their corresponding proteins.

pmc-11372423.title: Predictors of Cognitive Impairment among Filipino Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in a Tertiary Government Hospital
pmc-11372423.creator: Russell Anne Marie L. Carandang, Marissa T. Ong, Roy Alvin J. Malenab
pmc-11372423.description: BackgroundType 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) patients are predisposed to cognitive decline and dementia. The co-occurrence of the two diseases translate to a higher medical cost. Identification of factors contributing to cognitive impairment is warranted.ObjectiveTo determine the predictors of cognitive impairment among Filipino patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.

pmc-11679814.title: Facile Synthetic Access Towards Sulfur- and Selenium-Functionalized Boron-Based Multiresonance TADF Emitters
pmc-11679814.creator: Zeynep Güven, Hadi Dolati, Leo Wessel, René Frank
pmc-11679814.description: Thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) materials with high photoluminescence quantum yields and a fast reverse intersystem crossing (RISC) are of the highest interest for organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs). In the past decade, triaryl boranes with multiple resonance effect (MR) have captured significant attention.

pmc-13045387.title: Genomics of Caddisfly (Insecta: Trichoptera) Species Associated With Terrestrial Habitats
pmc-13045387.creator: Jacqueline Heckenhauer, Charlotte Gerheim, Gabriela Jijon, Steffen U Pauls, Robert W Wisseman, Paul B Frandsen
pmc-13045387.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Limnephilidae is a species‐rich and ecologically diverse family within the tube case making clade of caddisflies (Trichoptera). Species occur across a wide range of habitats, from cold headwater streams to stagnant pools to terrestrial environments. Here, we sequenced, assembled, and annotated whole genomes from two species that are associated with terrestrial environments: Enoicyla pusilla (Burmeister, 1839), distributed in the West Palearctic, and Philocasca rivularis (Wiggins, 1968), distributed in the Nearctic.

pmc-13080102.title: Efficacy of 5‐Hz Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Over the Left Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex in Improving Cognitive Function During the Recovery Phase of Stroke
pmc-13080102.creator: Hui‐xian Yu, Qian Diao, Yu‐juan Han, Bo Wei, Pei Dai
pmc-13080102.description: ObjectiveHere, we aimed to explore the efficacy of 5‐Hz transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) in improving cognitive function during the recovery phase of stroke.MethodThis was a retrospective study. A total of 33 patients were enrolled, of whom 13 received 5‐Hz TMS treatment and 20 did not. Cognitive functioning was assessed before and after treatment.

pmc-13203196.title: SPECTRA: A Conceptual Framework to Bridge Praxis and Remap Relational Violence in India Using a Complex Trauma Lens
pmc-13203196.creator: Maitrayee Sen, Snigdhaa Rajvanshi, Stuti Khandelwal, Simantini Ghosh
pmc-13203196.description: Domestic Violence affects 1 in 3 women worldwide. Empirical evidence from India suggests that women and girls experience a continuum of violence and discrimination from prenatal stages till death in families that largely continue to operate within a dominantly patriarchal framework.

pmc-13415540.creator: Anna Sallustio, Marisa Accogli, Davide Sacco, Marilina Santantonio, Vito Colella, Domenica Maria Di Palo, Serafina Rutigliano, Grazia Punzi, Francesca Centrone, Maria Chironna

We investigated NDM-producing E. coli bloodstream infections (BSIs) detected through regional Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) surveillance in Apulia, 2014–2025. Within the regional CRE surveillance (2014–2025), all carbapenem-resistant (CR) E.

pmc-13457605.title: Hierarchical lineage tracing reveals diverse pathways of cytarabine resistance
pmc-13457605.creator: Rachel Saxe, Hannah Stuart, Abigail C. Marshall, Fahiima Abdullahi, Zoë Chen, Francesco Emiliani, Aaron McKenna
pmc-13457605.description: Cancer cells adapt to treatment, leading to the emergence of clones that are more aggressive and resistant to anti-cancer therapies. We have a limited understanding of resistance mechanisms as we lack technologies to map cancer evolution under the selective pressure of treatment. To address this, we present a hierarchical, dynamic lineage-tracing method, FLARE (Following Lineage Adaptation and Resistance Evolution).

pmc-13655472.title: Effectiveness of Clinical Pathway Pop-Up Window Insertion in Computer-Based Prescription System for Antibiotic Stewardship in Acute Diarrhea
pmc-13655472.creator: Kotchawan Khumduang, Nattawat Larbsida, Wantin Sribenjalux
pmc-13655472.description: BackgroundAcute diarrhea is highly prevalent in Thailand, and inappropriate antibiotic use remains common. The effectiveness of a clinical pathway pop-up integrated into a computerized prescription system for antibiotic stewardship has not been previously evaluated.Materials and MethodsWe conducted a quasi-experimental study following implementation of a clinical pathway pop-up on 21 December 2021.

uslaw-usc-t38-s105.title: 38 U.S.C. § 105 — Line of duty and misconduct
uslaw-usc-t38-s105.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t38-s105.description: United States Code, Title 38 (Veterans’ Benefits); Part I (General Provisions); Chapter 1 (General). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) An injury or disease incurred during active military, naval, air, or space service will be deemed to have been incurred in line of duty and not the result of the veteran’s own misconduct when the person on whose account benefits are claimed.
